chapter: Rabbit Foot show and show life
title: Blues singer Sadie McKinney and the 101 Ranch show
summary: Sadie McKinney, a deep-voiced blues singer, worked with the Dash and Dinah show and 101 Ranch, a combined carnival and Western show with colored and white units.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Now, listen, there is a great blues singer that used to work with Dash and Diana show with me. Her name is Sadie McKinney. I don't know. She was a great song store with the 101 Ranch Show. There was a show you called 101 Ranch. Well, I've heard of that too. She was the great blues singer.
What kind of a show was that 101 Ranch?
It was one of the greatest carnival shows ever existed.
I thought maybe it was a Wild West show or something like that.
It was a carnival show and a Western show combined together.
That's why they called it 101 Ranch. It was a big show.
Were performers mostly colored or white?

Colored and white performers. Colored and white performers because they had two units that traveled together all the time. Colored and one of these units, they all put up on the same grounds, but in one of these units was a big tent where they had all the big white accents. And the other unit was where they had what you would call a regular minstrel show. That was the color. Blue singer. Well, Sadie McKinney was a great blues singer then. And I understand that she lives in St. Louis, Missouri now. Sadie McKinney.
I bet she never made any records. I don't think I ever saw any records.
I think she had made some.
I think she did, but I can't remember what company it was back in 1929. I can't remember any of the famous recording companies. I know Columbus was one. Victor.

The old O.K. and Paramount, but I don't even know the name. Maybe we'll have to try to look up some of the old catalogs and see if we can find her name anyplace. What kind of voice did you have? Deep voice? She had a big, deep voice. Heavy voice.

Her voice would sound like some men voice. She was a short woman, light brown skin, very nice looking. Sadie McKinney. She was a great blues singer. She's too old to sing now probably. Well, I imagine she all. Because at that time, she was in her 30s.
